prompt:
Use case: compositing / logo-brand. Refine and combine the TWO supplied CutVoke application icon concepts into ONE new unified original desktop app icon.
Reference image 1 (A, blue film ribbon): retain its cyan-to-ultramarine film-ribbon material, tasteful dimensional folding, a few large film perforations, and precise diagonal splice.
Reference image 2 (B, orange cut C): retain its immediately recognizable broad open capital C silhouette, strong sculptural ribbon construction, warm orange cut-face accent, and purposeful separated cut.
CRITICAL NEW REQUEST: the finished emblem must clearly contain BOTH uppercase C AND uppercase V, organically joined into ONE compact CV ligature. It must NOT read as only a C, only a V, a check mark, or a G.
Construct a large open C on the left. The C's lower ribbon flows downward into the sharp central valley of a clearly visible V, and the V's broad right arm rises toward the upper right. Share one diagonal cut/joint between C and V so this feels designed as one ribbon emblem rather than two pasted icons. Keep the C's open counter and the V's deep notch both unmistakable. The outer silhouette is balanced and compact. At most three large film sprocket holes on the upper-left C ribbon, not all around. No clutter.
Color: predominantly luminous cyan and rich cobalt blue, borrowed from A. Give the rising right V ribbon a restrained tangerine-orange folded face borrowed from B, around 20 percent of emblem area, creating an elegant blue/cyan and warm-orange combination. Use only one consistent restrained 3D material language, crisp smooth edges, broad clear surfaces. Bright clean colors, no texture/no grain/no excessive glow.
Backdrop: one midnight navy-charcoal rounded-square application tile matching the reference proportions. Transparent alpha ONLY outside the rounded tile; interior is opaque dark. Front-on orthographic view. Tile fills about 90% of square canvas; CV fills about 70% of the tile with generous safe margins. Prioritize legibility as a small 32px desktop icon. Produce exactly ONE large finished icon, no comparison sheet, no duplicate panels, no text labels, no CutVoke wordmark, no captions, no watermark, no mockup, no surrounding objects. Preserve polished professional app-icon quality of both references.
